stem.text: An ideal diode has zero resistance when forward biased and infinite resistance when reverse biased. The diode is connected in series with a $2\,\Omega$ resistor across the terminals of a source having electromotive force (e.m.f.) $3\,\text{V}$ and internal resistance $1\,\Omega$, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit with a source labelled 3 V and 1 Ω inside a dashed box, a 2 Ω resistor and a diode in series, and a voltmeter marked V across the diode and resistor.

stem.text: A high-resistance voltmeter is connected across the diode and resistor.
Which row gives the readings of the voltmeter for the two ways of connecting the diode?
